value.name: decides to carry the notes as paper
value.description: Asha realizes the marked page is now positioned between her and the windshield and accepts that she has already chosen to carry it with her as paper.
evidence: the page with the circled marks was now between her and the windshield instead of between her and the lamp, which meant she had already chosen to carry it the rest of the way as paper

value.name: starts the car
value.description: Asha turns the key and gets the engine running on the second try.
evidence: Asha turned the key and the engine caught on the second try

value.name: steadies the briefcase
value.description: After the dashboard lights her hands, Asha reaches over to steady the briefcase on the passenger seat.
evidence: the dashboard lighting her hands on the wheel before she reached over to steady the briefcase on the passenger seat

value.name: drives away toward the parkway
value.description: Asha backs out slowly and heads toward the parkway as the heater comes on cold.
evidence: She backed out slow, the street still dark at its edges, and took the corner toward the parkway with the heater ticking on cold

value.name: fixes on the briefcase without rehearsing
value.description: At a long light, Asha looks at the closed briefcase and realizes she is not rehearsing what to say to Whitfield.
evidence: At the first long light she let her eyes rest on the closed lid beside her
registered without surprise that she was not rehearsing what to say to Whitfield

value.name: commits to delivering the case
value.description: Asha understands she has already decided what is inside the case and that the drive is only the distance to the desk where she will place it.
evidence: she had already decided what was inside the case, and the drive was only the distance between that decision and the desk where she would set it down

value.name: keeps driving without calling
value.description: After the light changes, Asha keeps both hands on the wheel and does not reach for her phone.
evidence: She kept both hands on the wheel after the light changed, and did not reach for the phone in her coat pocket once
